title: Ruby Language Core
intro: Ruby interview questions at the intermediate level start with the language itself — the object model that underpins everything, mutability and freeze semantics, the truthiness rules that trip up engineers coming from other languages, and the comparisons interviewers return to in every round (== vs equal? vs eql?, Symbol vs String, freeze vs dup). This page covers the Ruby language fundamentals that map directly to the questions asked in backend engineering interviews at Rails-focused companies. For OOP-specific questions (class hierarchy, duck typing, method lookup) see the Ruby OOP page. For blocks, procs, and lambdas see the dedicated page — that topic demands its own full treatment. Every answer targets Ruby 3.3 idiomatic style: implicit returns, predicate methods with ?, bang methods with !, and safe navigation with &.
